gates.requirement: Impulse, tone, chirp, silence, deterministic noise, boundary, multichannel, and numerical-stability fixtures reconstruct within declared tolerances.
Coordinates match the pinned centered zero-padding convention and dense coefficient manifests verify.
The theoretical Gabor constant, realized spreads/product, lattice, candidate support, intervention support, projection, and refinement graph remain independent fields.
Changing hop density changes lattice density and redundancy but not the theoretical atom bound or realized window spread.
Sparse native candidates retain random occurrence IDs, deterministic semantic keys, native addresses, and candidate-only status.
Refinement constructs every nonempty proper subset before effects, terminates, certifies closure, and rejects an empty proper-node route as unavailable rather than qualification.
Mask, isolate, phase-coherent replacement, resynthesis-only, off-target, and alternate controls are deterministic, receipted, and replayable.
Native support and effective resynthesized support remain separate, and boundary effects are explicit.
Mock footprints prohibit physical claims, native measures prohibit cross-arm scale claims, and unsupported routes fail explicitly.
Every callable representation route returns OperationResult or a typed service outcome with a durable receipt; no route emits a DSQAssessment.
